about: Single source of truth for every pinned tool version that Ice Motion Director skills and scripts use. Skills and scripts read this file instead of repeating numbers. tests/metadata.test.mjs keeps requirements.txt files, script pins and exact pins written in skill text (name@x.y.z, name==x.y.z) in sync with it. .github/workflows/freshness.yml (scripts/freshness.mjs) compares it with the npm registry and PyPI every week, opens a pull request with the bump (never merged automatically) and opens an issue for any platform spec not verified within max_age_days. An entry with a hold field is never bumped.

node.why: hyperframes 0.8.174 declares engines node >=22; the skills installer (npm package skills 1.7.2) needs 22.20.0; _cdp.mjs and seam-gate.mjs use the global WebSocket of Node 22

python.why: numpy 2.4.6 and scipy 1.16.3 require Python 3.11 or newer; Python 3.10 reached end of life in October 2026

ffmpeg.why: engine-choice.md and render-html.mjs require FFmpeg 7 or newer (ffprobe ships with it)

chrome.pinned_by: the engine: npx hyperframes browser ensure (HyperFrames); HTML capture uses the installed Chrome, Chromium or Edge (render-html.mjs logs its version) or, when none exists, npx playwright-core install chromium from the project's pinned copy; both are installs without a question (engine-choice.md section 7.6), recorded
chrome.notes: Remotion HtmlInCanvas preview needs Chrome 149 or newer with the canvas draw-element flag (157 or newer for nesting)

hyperframes.use: HyperFrames CLI, installed in the film project as an exact dev dependency

remotion.use: Remotion; every remotion and @remotion/* package in a project uses this same exact version

playwright-core.use: optional driver for skills/ice-engines/scripts/render-html.mjs (it has a built-in driver when this is not installed)

lottie-web.use: Lottie player inside HyperFrames or an HTML capture page

canvaskit-wasm.use: Skottie player for standalone Lottie previews and exports (full build)

p5.use: painted styles on the HTML capture route (LGPL-2.1: load it, do not vendor a modified copy)

skills.use: universal installer named in the README (npx skills add)

pedalboard.note: 0.9.25 Linux x86_64 wheels use AVX-512 and die with SIGILL on CPUs without it; 0.9.26 targets the AVX baseline (spotify/pedalboard PR 511). the local gate imports every pin, one process per package (node scripts/gates.mjs --python)

matplotlib.note: 3.9.1 (the source pin) has no Windows wheels

playwright.note: then python -m playwright install chromium, an install without a question (engine-choice.md section 7.6), recorded

scenedetect.hold: 0.7.x depends on opencv-python (with GUI), which clashes with opencv-python-headless

vtracer.note: MIT (visioncortex); binary wheels for CPython 3.10 to 3.14 on Windows, macOS and Linux; used by vectorize.py (rung 3 of the ladder of art sources)

faster-whisper.note: MIT; local speech-to-text with word timestamps. In no requirements.txt: installed on demand into the project virtual environment without a question (engine-choice.md section 7.6); model files: models.whisper, cached under HF_HOME (section 7.7)

demucs.note: MIT; voice and music separation. Pulls PyTorch, a download of several hundred MB or more: check disk space first (engine-choice.md section 7.7). In no requirements.txt: installed on demand without a question (section 7.6); model: models.demucs

yt-dlp.note: Unlicense; fetch tool of the official-channel route (ice-assets sourcing-and-licenses.md section 1a). In no requirements.txt: installed on demand without a question (engine-choice.md section 7.6)

whisper.family: multilingual models only; .en models translate non-English audio into English
whisper.arabic_preferred: large-v3 or large-v3-turbo, or a dialect fine-tune when one exists
whisper.download: model files are fetched by the pinned faster-whisper on first use, without a question, into HF_HOME on a drive with room (engine-choice.md sections 7.6 and 7.7), recorded with size and folder

demucs.use: split a voice from music and noise (--two-stems vocals)
demucs.download: weights fetched by the pinned demucs on first use, without a question, into TORCH_HOME on a drive with room (engine-choice.md sections 7.6 and 7.7), recorded with size and folder

platform_specs.note: last_verified is the date the platform's live specs were last checked against its official help pages; null means the values were recorded from merged sources and never checked live.

instagram-reels.covers: 9:16 size, duration, safe zones, cover crop

facebook.covers: Reels and feed sizes, safe zones
